people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: I will take you, and you shall reign according to all that your soul desires, and shall be king over Israel.
translations.bsb: But as for you, I will take you, and you shall reign over all that your heart desires, and you will be king over Israel.
translations.kjv: And I will take thee, and thou shalt reign according to all that thy soul desireth, and shalt be king over Israel.
translations.asv: And I will take thee, and thou shalt reign according to all that thy soul desireth, and shalt be king over Israel.
